description: A hospital-at-home medical director must decide whether to activate a next-day home-hospital admission for a medically stable patient and finalize the equipment, authorization, caregiver, and medication arrangements needed to make the transition safe.

shared_context.S1: The patient is medically stable for either continued hospital observation or admission to the hospital-at-home program tomorrow.
shared_context.S2: Dr. Shah makes the final care-pathway decision and signs the transition orders.
shared_context.S3: The hospital-at-home program requires documented equipment, payer, caregiver, and medication arrangements before the patient leaves the hospital.
shared_context.S4: The patient lives alone in an apartment and has asked to return home if a safe hospital-at-home plan can be arranged.
shared_context.S5: At the daily transition huddle, Dr. Shah checks with respiratory therapy, utilization review, social work, and pharmacy before signing the plan.

PF1.text: During today's walk test, the patient desaturated with exertion and now requires continuous oxygen at 2 L/min; Luis confirmed that a portable concentrator and stationary backup can be delivered to the apartment by 15:00 tomorrow, allowing a home-hospital start at 16:00.

PF2.text: The patient's insurer approved hospital-at-home coverage only if the first skilled-nurse visit begins within four hours of arrival home and remote vital-sign monitoring is activated on the admission day; Keisha has the approval reference in the payer portal.

PF3.text: The patient's neighbor, Malik, signed the program's required caregiver agreement and will be physically present from 16:00 through 22:00 tomorrow, with a backup phone check at 08:00 the next morning; Nora has the signed agreement in her case-management folder.

PF4.text: The discharge medication changes include a new insulin pen that requires one supervised teaching dose before the first home dose; Evan prepared a seven-day labeled medication pack and can provide the teaching call at 17:00 tomorrow.

acceptance_conditions: The patient must be assigned to the hospital-at-home pathway.
The home-hospital admission must start at 16:00 tomorrow.
Continuous oxygen at exactly 2 L/min must be included in the transition plan.
Remote vital-sign monitoring must be activated on the admission day.
The first skilled-nurse visit must be scheduled within four hours of arrival home.
A caregiver-presence commitment covering 16:00 through 22:00 tomorrow and an 08:00 backup phone check must be recorded.
A seven-day labeled medication pack and supervised insulin teaching at 17:00 tomorrow must be recorded.
The oxygen equipment delivery commitment must specify both a portable concentrator and a stationary backup by 15:00 tomorrow.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'caregiver_presence' and c['target'] == 'Malik' and c['detail'] == 'present 16:00-22:00 tomorrow; backup phone check at 08:00 next morning' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'medication_teaching' and c['target'] == 'Patient' and c['detail'] == 'seven-day labeled medication pack and supervised insulin teaching at 17:00 tomorrow' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'oxygen_delivery' and c['target'] == 'Patient apartment' and c['detail'] == 'portable concentrator and stationary backup delivered by 15:00 tomorrow' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The walk-test result changes the oxygen order to exactly 2 L/min, and the confirmed equipment delivery by 15:00 makes a 16:00 home-hospital start and the specified equipment commitment feasible.
The payer approval changes the transition requirements to same-day remote monitoring and a first skilled-nurse visit within exactly four hours.
The signed agreement changes the caregiver plan from unavailable support to Malik's exact 16:00-22:00 presence and 08:00 backup phone check.
The medication review changes the discharge plan to a seven-day labeled pack plus a supervised insulin teaching session exactly at 17:00 tomorrow.
